test_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
label="$1"
python_bin="$2"
results_root="/workspace/m81-remediation/${label}-tests"
mkdir "$results_root"
export PATH=/workspace/m421-runtime-tools:$PATH
export MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/m81-mpl XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/m81-cache
export M3_CORE_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/m421-runtime-tools/CRISPResso
export M3_POOLED_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/m421-runtime-tools/CRISPRessoPooled
export M3_SAMTOOLS_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/m421-runtime-tools/samtools
export M3_CHILD_CORE_COMMAND=/CRISPResso2/.pixi/envs/default/bin/CRISPResso
export M31_RUNTIME_IMAGE=pinellolab/crispresso2@sha256:b7e7971a87769aa584d31d21e199a9abca5f641c4f889c2e807cb6324fc8ce0c
export M8_INTEGRATION=1
export M8_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m8" M81_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m81"
export M3_INTEGRATION=1 M31_INTEGRATION=1 M311_INTEGRATION=1 M312_INTEGRATION=1
export M4_INTEGRATION=1 M41_INTEGRATION=1 M42_INTEGRATION=1 M421_INTEGRATION=1 M422_INTEGRATION=1 M7_INTEGRATION=1
export M3_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m3" M31_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m31"
export M311_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m311" M312_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m312"
export M4_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m4" M41_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m41"
export M42_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m42" M421_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m421"
export M422_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m422" M7_RESULTS_DIR="$results_root/m7"
"$python_bin" -m pytest -q --basetemp="$results_root/pytest" --junitxml="$results_root/tests.xml" > "$results_root/tests.txt" 2>&1
wheel_build_install_script:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/m81-remediation');repo=Path('/workspace/crispresso-pe-pipeline-m81');python=root/'source-venv/bin/python'
while not (root/'source-tests/tests.xml').exists():time.sleep(5)
tree=ET.parse(root/'source-tests/tests.xml')
assert not tree.findall('.//failure') and not tree.findall('.//error') and not tree.findall('.//skipped')
print('Source suite passed:',len(tree.findall('.//testcase')),flush=True)
subprocess.run([str(python),'-m','build','--wheel','--no-isolation','--outdir',str(root/'dist')],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run([str(python),'-m','venv',str(root/'wheel-venv')],check=True)
wheelpython=root/'wheel-venv/bin/python'
subprocess.run([str(wheelpython),'-m','pip','install','-r',str(repo/'requirements-dev.lock'),str(next((root/'dist').glob('*.whl')))],check=True)
fixtures=root/'wheel-tests-input';fixtures.mkdir()
for name in ['tests','examples','docs']:shutil.copytree(repo/name,fixtures/name,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
shutil.copyfile(repo/'pyproject.toml',fixtures/'pyproject.toml')
code="import json,peanalyzer;from pathlib import Path;p=Path(peanalyzer.__file__).resolve();assert 'site-packages' in p.parts;assert peanalyzer.__version__=='0.8.0';print(json.dumps({'import_path':str(p),'version':peanalyzer.__version__}))"
identity=subprocess.check_output([str(wheelpython),'-c',code],cwd=fixtures,text=True)
(root/'wheel-install-identity.json').write_text(identity)
subprocess.run(['bash',str(root/'run-tests.sh'),'wheel',str(wheelpython)],cwd=fixtures,check=True)
print('Fresh wheel suite completed',flush=True)
